highlights.title: Clear weekend highlights in dark mode
highlights.description: Saturday and Sunday calendar days and column headers now feature warm, high-contrast amber styling with crisp borders in both dark and light modes.

highlights.title: Weekend protection on special holidays
highlights.description: Special holidays cannot be applied for weekends, keeping official non-working rest days properly excluded from leave applications.

highlights.title: Streamlined cloud deployments
highlights.description: Removed package manager conflicts and configured robust npm installation for reliable Vercel builds.

releaseNotes: Restore cross-platform lockfile for zero-failure GitHub Actions CI builds, clear amber weekend highlights in dark and light modes, and weekend protection for special holidays.
